# Change Case agents

Source: `modules/agents/registry.py`. Design: [multi-agent-trust.md](../design-docs/multi-agent-trust.md).

## Multi-agent patterns used

| Pattern | Use |
|---|---|
| Supervisor (hierarchical) | A deterministic supervisor plans the run and assembles the result. |
| Parallel fan-out | Agents in the same stage run at the same time. |
| Sequential stages with shared state | Later stages read earlier results from a shared case record (blackboard). |
| Independent verifier (critic) | A rule-based agent checks the language-model agents against the knowledge graph. |
| Human in the loop | Every case ends with human checkpoints; allocation is advice, not decision authority. |

## Run order

1. Knowledge Retrieval Agent and Impact & Dependency Agent (in parallel)
2. Risk Assessment Agent and Review Requirements Agent (in parallel)
3. Cost & Downtime Agent and Decision Allocation Agent (in parallel)
4. Verification Agent

## Agents

| Agent | Stage | Basis | Role | Knowledge sources | Reuses | Uses results of |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supervisor | 0 | deterministic | Plans the assessment, runs the agents stage by stage (in parallel within a stage), isolates failures and assembles the case record. Its routing is fixed code, not a model decision. | User input | `modules.agents.supervisor.Supervisor` | - |
| Knowledge Retrieval Agent | 1 | retrieval | Finds past changes, hazards, incidents and lessons related to the proposed change. | Engineering records, Knowledge graph | `core.rag_pipeline.HybridRetriever.retrieve`, `core.vector_store.VectorStore.search`, `core.neo4j_client.Neo4jClient` | - |
| Impact & Dependency Agent | 1 | deterministic | Traces which equipment, areas and processes the change reaches, and how downtime would propagate. | Ontology, Knowledge graph, Computational model | `modules.decision_allocation.graph_store.get_asset_facts`, `modules.decision_allocation.graph_store.get_reach`, `core.downtime_propagator.DowntimePropagator.propagate` | - |
| Risk Assessment Agent | 2 | llm | Identifies the main risks, their severity and mitigations, from graph evidence. | Knowledge graph, Engineering records, LLM interpretation | `modules.risk_engine.RiskEngine.analyse`, `core.llm.gateway (structured output)` | - |
| Review Requirements Agent | 2 | llm | Suggests approvers, required documents and whether HAZOP and PSSR reviews are needed. | Knowledge graph, Engineering documents, Engineering records, LLM interpretation | `modules.smart_forms.SmartFormModule.get_prefill_suggestions`, `core.llm.gateway (structured output)` | - |
| Cost & Downtime Agent | 3 | ml | Estimates cost and downtime with ranges, and explains the estimate. | ML model, Knowledge graph, LLM interpretation | `modules.cost_predictor.CostPredictor.predict` | Impact & Dependency Agent, Risk Assessment Agent |
| Decision Allocation Agent | 3 | deterministic | Recommends whether the decision should be AI-led, AI-supported or human-led. | Computational model, Knowledge graph, Assumption | `modules.decision_allocation.service.DecisionAllocationService.assess_change`, `core.allocation.engine.score` | Risk Assessment Agent, Review Requirements Agent |
| Verification Agent | 4 | rule | Checks the language-model agents' claims against the knowledge graph and each other; sets human checkpoints. | Knowledge graph, Engineering records, Engineering documents | `modules.agents.verifier (fixed rules)`, `core.neo4j_client.Neo4jClient` | Knowledge Retrieval Agent, Impact & Dependency Agent, Risk Assessment Agent, Review Requirements Agent, Cost & Downtime Agent, Decision Allocation Agent |
